Print Production Preview

Best print path: finish the directory and pins here, click Refresh Print Preview, then use Print / Save Both Sides PDF. In the print dialog, choose Save as PDF, scale 100%, and turn off browser headers/footers. The SVG download is a design file and will open in Chrome; use Chrome’s Print > Save as PDF if you need a PDF from it.

The directory text, pins, logo, and map title are redrawn as clean HTML/SVG-style elements for better print sharpness, and the old baked-in map title/subtitle is covered. The map background is still the current artwork image, so the final street/building softness depends on that source image.
